title: Aurem
tagline: Configurable multi-store e-commerce platform and merchant dashboard
description: Aurem is a configurable multi-store e-commerce platform and merchant dashboard built for high-concurrency order handling, automated logistics, and lightning-fast storefront performance.
longDescription: Aurem was architected from the ground up to solve critical merchant pain points: race-condition overselling during flash sales, clunky third-party courier dispatch, and slow client-side page loads. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, and MongoDB, it features atomic inventory updates, role-based session auth with Better Auth, and a media pipeline powered by Cloudflare R2.

features.text: Atomic inventory locks to prevent overselling during checkout spikes.
Role-based admin & customer sessions using Better Auth HTTP-only cookies.
Automated courier dispatch integration via Steadfast API with address validation.
High-throughput media pipeline using Cloudflare R2 with image optimization.

challengesSolved: Atomic Inventory Locking: Prevented stock overselling under concurrent checkouts by replacing read-then-write loops with atomic decrement operators with conditional bounds ($gte).
Enterprise Session Security: Implemented Better Auth for secure, tamper-proof session persistence across merchant subdomains using HTTP-only cookies.
Automated Logistics Flow: Integrated Steadfast Courier API directly inside the fulfillment pipeline, eliminating manual tracking number entries.

title: CashBook
tagline: Progressive Web App built for local-first speed with background cloud synchronization
description: CashBook is an expense and financial ledger tracking progressive web app built for local-first instant input with automated background cloud synchronization and zero floating-point discrepancies.
longDescription: Traditional ledger apps require an active internet connection, causing annoying latency when logging transactions on the go. CashBook solves this by implementing a true local-first architecture powered by Dexie.js and IndexedDB, backed by PostgreSQL, Neon serverless, and Drizzle ORM. Users can log hundreds of entries in zero-connectivity areas, which seamlessly sync via idempotent delta-queues upon reconnecting.

features.text: Local-first architecture using Dexie.js & IndexedDB with zero network latency.
Background sync engine with delta-sync and idempotency keys to resolve conflicts.
Currency stored in integer units (cents/paisa) to eliminate floating-point calculation errors.
PostgreSQL schema designed with Drizzle ORM using composite indexes.

challengesSolved: Zero-Latency Offline Recording: Built client-side transactional models using IndexedDB, enabling instant UI feedback regardless of network state.
Idempotent Delta-Sync: Devised a deterministic reconciliation engine using monotonic timestamps and client-generated UUIDs that guarantees zero duplicate transactions.
Financial Precision: Strictly mandated integer arithmetic throughout database schemas and API layers, eradicating standard JavaScript floating-point roundoff issues.

title: VectorFitLab
tagline: Training platform for coaches and athletes with video courses, scheduling, and enrollment
description: VectorFitLab is an all-in-one training and educational platform for fitness professionals, featuring secure Vimeo video streaming, automated SSLCommerz payments, and role-based training programs.
longDescription: Designed to provide fitness coaches with a professional direct-to-consumer platform, VectorFitLab incorporates high-throughput resumable video uploads, course module progress gating, and real-time coupon calculation. Built using Next.js 16, Redux Toolkit, Express, MongoDB, and Zod validation.

features.text: Video delivery infrastructure using Vimeo APIs with resumable TUS uploads.
Payment gateway integration with SSLCommerz, coupon validation, and IPN webhooks.
Role-based route protection for Admins, Trainers, and Athletes with HTTP-only cookies.
Strict runtime request payload and response validation with Zod.

challengesSolved: Resumable Video Ingestion: Built a TUS client integration with Vimeo API to permit large 4K workout video uploads with auto-resume on connection drops.
Multi-Role Permission Guarding: Structured hierarchical JWT middleware guaranteeing athlete records are only readable by their assigned certified trainers and admins.
Robust Payment Verification: Configured SSLCommerz IPN (Instant Payment Notification) listener with signature verification to prevent spoofed purchase confirmations.

title: RedLabStudio
tagline: Learning management platform built for client delivery, online course administration, and student tracking
description: RedLabStudio is a full-featured video course academy platform with structured modules, automated certificate issuing, Tiptap rich-text course creation, and SSLCommerz checkout.
longDescription: Built to deliver a frictionless learning experience, RedLabStudio enables instructors to create interactive courses with rich-text lessons, attachments, and gated chapter progression. When students complete all required modules, verified certificates are generated dynamically.

features.text: Multi-role permission system covering Admins, Instructors, and Students.
Video lesson streaming, module ordering, and lesson progress tracking.
Course purchase workflows with SSLCommerz, automated enrollment, and coupon codes.
Tiptap rich-text editor integration for course material and certificates.

challengesSolved: Custom Rich-Text Lesson Authoring: Integrated and customized Tiptap editor with syntax highlighting, custom callout blocks, and video embeds.
Progress Progression Gating: Engineered course progress calculation that unlocks sequential modules only after prerequisite video lessons are marked complete.
Automated Certificate Generation: Developed an automated certificate templating engine that stamps student name, verification ID, and issuance date upon 100% course completion.
